purpose: Public-source capability register for planning a matched engineering-change impact and evidence-applicability benchmark. Vendor statements are not independently reproduced performance results.

vendors.source_revision_or_date: Teamcenter 2606 announcement 2026-06-12; Teamcenter X engineering-change workflow post 2026-08-11
capabilities: BOM-aware AI agent for multi-step change workflows with human oversight
AI-assisted MBSE requirement checks and parameter linking
AI-generated test-case recommendations and verification-coverage assistance
change recommendations and rules-based workflow routing
large-scale digital-thread visualization and impact analysis
change requests linked to impacted products, documents, requirements, approvals and release
vendors.benchmark_relevance: Direct candidate for engineering-change, requirements, BOM-impact and workflow-orchestration comparison.
prerequisites_or_known_boundaries: Exact Teamcenter edition, deployment, product configuration, model, Copilot/agent versions and licensing must be recorded.
Public vendor documentation does not provide independent accuracy, false-negative, stale-evidence, cost-per-accepted-decision or matched 24-case results.
The public feature description does not establish independent claim-evidence applicability adjudication or independent effect reconstruction.

vendors.source_revision_or_date: Impact Analysis AI Agent v1.0.0 general availability announced 2026-03-23; v1.0.1 release notes 2026-08-18
capabilities: five AI specialist agents analyze change-request context, product structure and historical change orders
a recommendation validator consolidates the affected-item recommendation set
recommendations carry suggested Revise/Release/Obsolete action and rationale
human reviews and selectively applies affected-item relationships
applied rationale is written into the change record; the change request remains in Draft and normal UCM approval continues
vendors.benchmark_relevance: Most directly documented AI change-impact comparator; a mandatory target for the industrial-change pilot if a licensed, representative environment can be accessed.
prerequisites_or_known_boundaries: The change request needs substantive title/reason/description; product structure relationships must be complete.
Custom item types without a present/unique item_number may be skipped or misidentified.
Only Draft-state change requests are presented for analysis.
The agent can write affected-item relationships in one operation after user approval; it does not itself promote the change request through lifecycle approval.
Customer-specific deployment and configuration are described as a separately contracted professional-services engagement.
Five specialist agents and a recommendation validator are not five independent human reviewers or five independent failure domains.
Public documentation does not report independent gold-set accuracy, critical impact recall, evidence-applicability confusion matrix, human time or cost per accepted result.

vendors.source_revision_or_date: Windchill Help Center 13.1.2.0 documentation snapshot accessed 2026-11-13
capabilities: change impact analysis collects affected local and external objects
upstream and downstream linked-object collection for parts and remote requirements
change requests, notices, implementation plans, affected objects and change review roles
trace links connect external requirements to parts and other traceable objects
vendors.benchmark_relevance: Strong conventional PLM/requirements traceability baseline; compare the vendor-native change workflow and linked-object impact set, not just the underlying graph traversal.
prerequisites_or_known_boundaries: Exact Windchill modules, versions, integrations, configuration and supported remote object types must be pinned.
A collected affected-object relationship is not automatically an independently adjudicated evidence-applicability disposition.
Public documentation does not provide matched 24-case accuracy, stale-evidence false-current rate or total fully burdened cost.

vendors.source_revision_or_date: IBM documentation for DOORS Next 7.2.0 accessed 2026-11-13
capabilities: requirement traceability through links, tags, attributes, filtering, workflows and dashboards
links between requirements and other requirements, development artifacts and test artifacts
vendors.benchmark_relevance: Requirements-management adjunct baseline; not a stand-alone PLM or full engineering-change execution baseline. Can be paired with a named PLM system where that integration is available.
prerequisites_or_known_boundaries: Exact DOORS Next release, modules, integrations and external PLM pairing must be declared.
Do not score it as a complete change-management system when only the requirements-traceability component is provisioned.
Public documentation does not establish claim-evidence applicability adjudication across physical tests, as-built articles, calibration or manufacturing evidence.

cross_vendor_findings: Commercial PLM vendors already provide mature change records, product structures, linked-object impact, workflow routing, review and audit trail capabilities.
AI-assisted change-impact recommendations are now a documented commercial capability, not a unique Luminous category.
The Aras Impact Analysis AI Agent is a direct comparator and must be included before making a broad claim that Luminous is ahead of industry AI-assisted change impact.

Public materials reviewed do not establish whether these products provide the exact ten-state claim-evidence applicability contract owned by Symthaea #10581; absence from public documentation is not proof that the feature is absent.
No vendor access, tenant, license, implementation, benchmark task, price quote or performance result was obtained in this research pass.
differentiation_hypothesis: Move beyond an affected-item list to claim–evidence pair decisions with scoped preservation witnesses, exact recalculation, review, retest, physical evidence, external approval, unknown and unsupported states.
Measure both critical under-impact and unnecessary over-requalification; do not reward either preserve-everything or requalify-everything.
Independently reconstruct why each affected claim/evidence decision is valid, using evidence manifests and owner-qualified semantics rather than only a model-generated rationale.
Preserve the system of record and professional approval authority; the agent proposes applicability obligations but does not approve, release, sign or actuate.
Operate across vendor boundaries while retaining exact source identity, version, evidence provenance and unsupported semantics.
Compete on total cost per independently accepted engineering-change assessment, including human review, integration, rework and verification.
claim_ceiling: Documented capability map only. No vendor system was accessed, run, independently graded, priced or compared on the 24-case corpus. No Luminous superiority or SOTA claim.
